text: A data center never sleeps. Neither can its power.
Electricity arrives from the grid, and a transformer steps it down to about four hundred volts.
Then it meets the low-voltage switchgear.
Inside, a main breaker lets power onto heavy copper busbars.
Feeder breakers share it out: to the U P S, the cooling, the server racks.
asr: Feeder breakers share it out to the UPS the cooling the server racks

text: When a cable faults, only the breaker closest to it trips.
And if the grid goes dark?
The U P S batteries hold the servers while the generator starts.
asr: The UPS batteries hold the servers while the generator starts

text: The switchgear changes source, never connecting both at once, and power flows again.
Switch. Protect. Transfer. Every second, of every day.
